findings.original_evidence: Stage 6 evaluation passed 51/53: current_reduced_movement expected S-CLARIFY although no rule matched; historical_report_plan omitted observed S-CLARIFY.
findings.correction: Corrected metadata only, added exact reasons/stop/attribution assertions and two contrast regressions. User-visible routes and generation permissions were unchanged.
findings.verification: Stage 6 55/55; critical 51/51; urgent zero generation 27/27; conservative clarification 19/19.

findings.original_evidence: Personal provider availability could be checked before returning an already-determined urgent or clarification safety result.
findings.correction: Moved urgent and unresolved clarification exits before provider availability checks.

findings.original_evidence: Substring matching allowed the token eat inside peanut to create an unintended nutrition signal.
findings.correction: Replaced substring keyword matching with whole-word matching.
findings.verification: Stage 7 routing and fan-out 25/25; full Stage 7 evaluation 76/76.

findings.original_evidence: Stage boundaries lacked one explicit typed gate for Personal, Demo and evaluation context provenance.
findings.correction: Added strict runtime modes, context origin, authenticated snapshot binding, onboarding/confirmation/conflict/stale-state stops and explicit plan-action enforcement.
findings.verification: Cross-stage integration and runtime isolation tests pass in the 418/418 full Python suite.

findings.original_evidence: A configured provider boundary and benchmark result contract were incomplete.
findings.correction: Added injected, provider-neutral fail-closed adapters and a benchmark harness/report that records zero paid calls and no selected provider.
findings.verification: Provider boundary/harness tests pass. Live provider status remains NO-GO pending authorization and benchmark.

findings.original_evidence: The visible deterministic semantic suite needed harder negative cases.
findings.correction: Added opposite-conclusion, split-claim, allergy-specific and movement-intensity mismatch cases.

findings.original_evidence: Reduced-movement wording exposes an unresolved distinction between generic fallback and draft S-FETAL matching.
findings.correction: No clinical rule was added or approved. Both phrases are regression tested with zero ordinary generation and public routing disabled.
findings.verification: Safety spec remains draft; review packet records the open qualified-review requirement.

findings.original_evidence: Accepted baseline contains no Stage 9 implementation or Stage 9 checker.
findings.correction: No Stage 9 code was invented. Existing Stage 3/4 Streamlit smoke checks were run.
findings.verification: Controlled Stage 9 engineering may begin; Stage 9 product completion is not claimed.

findings.original_evidence: The first post-cleanup compileall run found a SyntaxError in app/services/model_provider.py because a broad PowerShell replacement removed three closing delimiters.
findings.correction: Restored the exact three delimiters and retained only intended blank-line formatting.
findings.verification: Affected tests 48/48, compileall passed, then the complete Python suite passed 418/418.
